火山剖面；先看储存区受压、裂隙张开，再追踪岩浆上升。气泡、喷流与时间均为教学示意: Volcano cross section: first watch the storage region pressurize and fractures open, then follow rising magma. Bubbles, jets and time are illustrative.
地下供浆、岩浆浮力与压力差会让储存区受压；构造应力和原有裂隙决定岩脉更容易往哪里: Magma supply, buoyancy and pressure differences can pressurize a storage region; tectonic stress and existing fractures influence where dikes open most readily. Crustal movement does not trigger an eruption every time.
岩浆向上走时，周围压力降低，原本溶在里面的气体形成气泡并膨胀。: As magma rises, surrounding pressure falls. Dissolved gases form bubbles and expand.
岩浆到地表就叫熔岩。它可以从山顶喷出，也能从山坡或裂缝里的多个喷口出来。: Magma at the surface is called lava. It can emerge at the summit, on a flank or through several vents along cracks.
岩浆系统包含储存区、岩脉和通道。浮力、压力差、气体析出及构造条件共同影响运移与喷: Magma systems include storage regions, dikes and conduits. Buoyancy, pressure differences, gas exsolution and tectonic conditions influence magma transport and eruption.
上升减压促进挥发分出溶。高黏度岩浆通常更难让气体逸出，但实际行为还受温度、晶体含: Decompression promotes volatile exsolution. Viscous magma generally retains gas more readily, but temperature, crystals and supply rate also affect behavior.
富气且黏稠的岩浆更易发生碎裂和爆炸式喷发；流动性较强的岩浆常形成熔岩流或喷泉。这: Gas-rich, viscous magma is more prone to fragmentation and explosive eruption. More fluid magma often produces flows or fountains. This compares tendencies, not real eruption forecasts.
多个喷口可与分支通道或裂隙系统相连。本页在喷口间分配同一示意供给量，多喷口并不自: Multiple vents may connect to branching conduits or fissures. This illustration divides one notional supply among vents; more vents do not automatically multiply eruption energy.
试着把气体和黏稠程度调低，再调高，比较“向下流”和“向上喷”的不同。真实火山常把: Lower gas content and viscosity, then increase them. Compare downward flows and upward jets. Real volcanoes can combine several styles and change between eruptions.

地下岩浆常以熔体、晶体与气体混合物存在于储存区和裂隙网络中。岩浆与围岩的密度差、: Subsurface magma is commonly a mixture of melt, crystals and gas within storage regions and fracture networks. Density contrast, reservoir pressure and tectonic stress help determine whether it rises through dikes and conduits.
ΔP_b 是高度 H 上的浮力压差估计；围岩比岩浆密时该项有利于上升。它不是完整: ΔP_b estimates buoyancy pressure over height H; denser host rock favors ascent. It is not a complete eruption criterion: conduit resistance and stress conditions also matter.

岩浆上升时压力降低，部分溶解挥发分可从熔体中出溶形成气泡。已有气泡也会随压力降低: As magma ascends and pressure falls, some dissolved volatiles exsolve into bubbles, while existing gas expands. Whether bubbles connect and escape influences degassing and the conditions for fragmentation.

停在上升阶段，比较通道下部与上部气泡的大小。: Pause during ascent and compare bubbles lower and higher in the conduit.
气泡不是普通空气；火山气体可包括水汽、二氧化碳和二氧化硫等。: The bubbles are not ordinary air; volcanic gases can include water vapor, carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide.
黏度影响流动和气泡逸出，气体膨胀能驱动喷泉或使岩浆碎裂。温度、成分、晶体含量、上: Viscosity affects flow and bubble escape, while gas expansion can drive fountains or fragmentation. Temperature, composition, crystals, ascent rate and external water also matter: low-viscosity magma can erupt explosively, so one slider cannot classify real eruptions.
τ 为剪切应力，η 为动力黏度，γ̇ 为剪切速率。这是牛顿流体的参考关系；含晶体: τ is shear stress, η dynamic viscosity and γ̇ shear rate. This is a Newtonian reference relation; crystal- and bubble-bearing magma may depart strongly from it.
把气体和黏稠程度先调低、再调高，比较贴着山坡流动的熔岩和向上散开的物质。: Lower gas and viscosity, then raise them. Compare lava traveling down slopes with material ejected upward.
红橙色代表高温物质，不是普通火焰。火山灰是细小岩石、矿物和玻璃颗粒，也不是燃烧后: Red and orange represent hot material, not ordinary flame. Volcanic ash consists of fine rock, mineral and glass fragments, not combustion ash.
岩脉可沿裂隙侧向传播，让岩浆从山坡或裂缝上的多个位置到达地表。喷口之间分配同一系: Dikes can propagate laterally along fractures, allowing magma to reach the surface at multiple flank or fissure vents. Vents share supply from a system; more vents do not automatically multiply total erupted volume or hazard.
Q_i 是各喷口的体积流率。这里将固定的示意颗粒供给分给各喷口；真实分配受通道尺: Q_i is each vent’s volumetric flow rate. A fixed illustrative particle supply is divided among vents here; real partitioning depends on geometry, pressure and rheology and need not be equal.
冷却阶段的颜色变暗只表示表面降温趋势，不对应真实冷却时长；内部可能仍然很热。: Darkening during cooling indicates a surface trend, not a measured cooling time; interiors may remain hot.

这组条件更容易使岩浆碎裂。细灰随上升气体卷入空气，形成不断扩展的灰云，较粗的碎块: These conditions favor fragmentation. Rising gas and fine ash entrain air into an expanding cloud, while coarser fragments fall sooner.

熔岩、火山灰或其他碎屑正在出来，是当前喷发的证据。喷发可以以流动为主，也可以以爆: Lava, ash or other fragments being emitted are evidence of an ongoing eruption. It may be mostly effusive or explosive.
看实际喷出物，并结合地震、地表形变、气体与热观测。单独一缕白气不等于岩浆正在喷出: Observe erupted material together with earthquakes, ground deformation, gas and heat. A white plume alone does not show that magma is erupting.
“活火山”并不等于每天都在喷；目前正在喷发只是其中一种状态。: An active volcano need not erupt every day; ongoing eruption is one possible state.
休眠期：现在安静，仍可能再喷: Dormant: quiet now, but may erupt again
“休眠”常用来描述火山喷发之间的安静时期。过去的喷发层、年代和地下活动线索，让科: Dormant often describes a quiet interval between eruptions. Dated deposits and subsurface clues can indicate a system that may erupt again.
一起研究岩层年代、历史记录、地震、形变和气体；安静很久也不能只靠外观宣布它“死了: Study rock ages, historical records, earthquakes, deformation and gas together. A long quiet interval cannot establish extinction from appearance alone.
“休眠”的用法并不完全统一，很多休眠火山仍属于广义的活火山；没有统一的几年倒计时: Usage of dormant varies. Many dormant volcanoes are active in the broader sense; there is no universal countdown in years.
“死火山”通常指科学家根据地质历史和供浆背景，认为不太可能再次喷发的火山。它是一: Extinct usually describes a volcano judged unlikely to erupt again, based on its geological history and magma-supply setting. It is an evidence-based assessment that can be revised.
依据现有证据，不预期再喷: No further eruption expected from current evidence
需要较完整的地质年代和构造、岩浆供给背景，不能用山上长草、没有烟或某个固定年数代: Geological ages, tectonic setting and magma supply matter. Grass, a lack of visible emissions or a fixed number of years cannot replace that evidence.
长得安静不等于已熄灭；一处旧喷口不再活动，也不保证整个火山区不会出现新喷口。: Quiet appearance does not establish extinction. An old vent becoming inactive does not rule out a new vent elsewhere in its volcanic field.

地下支撑条件改变时，地面可大范围塌陷。它不只是山顶被“炸飞”，有些后来会积水成湖: Changes in subsurface support can cause extensive collapse. A caldera is more than a summit being blown off; some later hold lakes.

以大室山为例认识火山渣锥：喷出的多孔碎屑落在喷口周围，山形在喷发时就已建立。画面: Use Omuroyama to explore a scoria cone: porous volcanic fragments collect around a vent, building its shape during eruption. The scene is conceptual, not a surveyed reconstruction.

先有喷口，再有落回周围的碎屑；不是一座普通山忽然点起火。: A vent opens and fragments fall around it; this is not an ordinary mountain catching fire.
火山渣与火山弹落下、堆积，建立山坡和中央火山口。大室山的活动还曾让熔岩从山麓流出: Scoria and volcanic bombs accumulate into slopes around a crater. Omuroyama’s eruption also produced lava from the foot of the cone.
这一段喷发结束，锥形山与火山口已经留下。不能把这种山形当成所有死火山的模样。: This eruptive episode ends with the cone and crater already present. This is not a universal shape for extinct volcanoes.
土壤与植被后来覆盖山坡。大室山的草地还受人为山烧维护；旧喷口结束活动，也不代表整: Soil and vegetation later cover the slopes. Traditional burning maintains Omuroyama’s grassland; an inactive old vent does not rule out new vents in the volcanic field.
从海底熔岩到可能的岛屿: From seafloor lava to a possible island
海水改变熔岩的冷却和喷发环境。比较深水、浅水和长期成岛三个情境，它们不是每座海底: Seawater changes cooling and eruption conditions. Compare deep water, shallow water and long-term island building; they are not inevitable stages of every submarine volcano.
在成岛情境中改变供给历史，比较露出海面的山和始终留在水下的海山。: In the island case, compare sustained and limited supply: an island or a seamount that remains submerged.
岩浆来到海底喷口。深水、浅水与长期堆积分别选择了不同条件和时间尺度。: Magma reaches a seafloor vent. The three scenarios select different conditions and timescales.
深水例子里，熔岩外层迅速结壳，新的熔岩团块继续长出；浅水例子观察岩浆与水相互作用: In the deep example, lava skins solidify as new lobes grow; the shallow example explores magma–water interaction.
成岛需要足够多的物质堆积。只有部分海底火山能够长到海面以上，水下仍藏着巨大的山体: An island needs enough accumulated material. Only some submarine volcanoes reach the surface, with a large mountain still below water.
喷出的物质留下岩石；成岛片段最后还展示海浪侵蚀。热液活动与正在喷出熔岩是不同的事: Erupted material leaves rock; the island sequence also ends with wave erosion. Hydrothermal activity differs from an ongoing lava eruption.
火山口或塌陷形成的破火山口可以成为湖盆。能否积水，还取决于水的补给、渗漏和出口。: A crater or collapse caldera can provide a basin. Water accumulation also depends on supply, leakage and outlets.
